vulnerability.name: USN-5404-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5404-1 addressed a vulnerability in Rsyslog. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:  Pieter Agten discovered that Rsyslog incorrectly handled certain requests. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a crash.

statements.status_notes: Rsyslog could be made to crash if it received a specially crafted request. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
